entries.text: You see General Maxson.
entries.source_text: You see General Maxson.

entries.text: What's the Brotherhood really about?
entries.source_text: What's the Brotherhood really about?

entries.text: I'll bet you know a lot of the history behind the Brotherhood.
entries.source_text: I'll bet you know a lot of the history behind the Brotherhood.

entries.text: Heard any good rumors?
entries.source_text: Heard any good rumors?

entries.text: I have some information to report.
entries.source_text: I have some information to report.

entries.text: That's all. Thanks.
entries.source_text: That's all. Thanks.

entries.text: Hello, youngster. Cabbot said you wanted to talk. Look I'm uh . . . I'm pretty stacked up right now, so I'll uh . . . I'll help you out as long as you don't start flappin' your gums too much. You know, outsiders are like that, always jawin' . . . Hehehe. Kinda like me, huh?
entries.source_text:
Hello, youngster. Cabbot said you wanted to talk. Look I'm uh . . .
 I'm pretty stacked up right now, so I'll uh . . . I'll help you out as long
 as you don't start flappin' your gums too much. You know, outsiders are like that,
 always jawin' . . . Hehehe. Kinda like me, huh?

entries.text: Outsiders? What do you mean by that?
entries.source_text: Outsiders? What do you mean by that?

entries.text: How 'bout a few questions then?
entries.source_text: How 'bout a few questions then?

entries.text: I can't. I just moderate these endless damn meetings. There's four Elders, and me, you see? I break up fights and tie votes. Now, if all four vote to pick our noses while an army rolls in here and kicks our collective butt, there's not a helluva lot I can do about it.
entries.source_text:
I can't. I just moderate these endless damn meetings. There's four Elders,
 and me, you see? I break up fights and tie votes. Now, if all four vote to pick our
 noses while an army rolls in here and kicks our collective butt, there's not a helluva
 lot I can do about it.

entries.text: Oh, well.
entries.source_text: Oh, well.

entries.text: That stinks. Why don't you do something?
entries.source_text: That stinks. Why don't you do something?

entries.text: Tradition. It's hard to change our ways. Now, maybe if the Elders had some real info, they'd get off their brains and do something.
entries.source_text: Tradition. It's hard to change our ways. Now, maybe if the Elders had some real info, they'd get off their brains and do something.

entries.text: An Initiate not born here. You're the first Outsider we've let join in a long, long time. Well, near on twenty years now.
entries.source_text:
An Initiate not born here. You're the first Outsider we've let join in
 a long, long time. Well, near on twenty years now.

entries.text: Why me?
entries.source_text: Why me?

entries.text: I'm flattered. How about some of those questions now?
entries.source_text: I'm flattered. How about some of those questions now?

entries.text: Because we need to do something. An army's gatherin', Hub-caravans are disappearin', and our scouts sure as hell ain't gettin' the job done. So the Elders actually did something once and figured the right Outsider might have something to offer. That Outsider is you... We hope.
entries.source_text:
Because we need to do something. An army's gatherin', Hub-caravans are
 disappearin', and our scouts sure as hell ain't gettin' the job done.
 So the Elders actually did something once and figured the right
 Outsider might have something to offer. That Outsider is you... We hope.

entries.text: What army?
entries.source_text: What army?

entries.text: What about these missing caravans?
entries.source_text: What about these missing caravans?

entries.text: Hmm. I guess there are some more things I need to ask then.
entries.source_text: Hmm. I guess there are some more things I need to ask then.

entries.text: What's the problem with the scouts?
entries.source_text: What's the problem with the scouts?

entries.text: I have some info you might want.
entries.source_text: I have some info you might want.

entries.text: When we heard about the missing caravans, we sent out a few scouts east and the north. The ones who went north never returned. One came back from the east. He talked about a score of strange beings, all muscle with burnin' eyes. The Elder's aren't doin' squat, but I'm getting ready just the same.
entries.source_text:
When we heard about the missing caravans, we sent out a few
 scouts east and the north. The ones who went north never returned. One came
 back from the east. He talked about a score of strange beings, all muscle
 with burnin' eyes. The Elder's aren't doin' squat, but I'm getting ready
 just the same.

entries.text: Twenty isn't an army. Why are you worried?
entries.source_text: Twenty isn't an army. Why are you worried?

entries.text: Sounds like your guy baked in the sun too long.
entries.source_text: Sounds like your guy baked in the sun too long.

entries.text: I'll do what I can.
entries.source_text: I'll do what I can.

entries.text: Did he say where to the east?
entries.source_text: Did he say where to the east?

entries.text: I have some info you might want.
entries.source_text: I have some info you might want.

entries.text: They may or may not be good scouts, but don't question the truthfulness of my men. We can revoke your Initiate status at any time.
entries.source_text:
They may or may not be good scouts, but don't question
 the truthfulness of my men. We can revoke your Initiate status at any time.

entries.text: Sounds like you need me more than I need you.
entries.source_text: Sounds like you need me more than I need you.

entries.text: Sorry.
entries.source_text: Sorry.

entries.text: That's it. I warned the Elders that bringin' in an Outsider could be trouble. (shouting aside) Guards! There's an Initiate here who needs some quiet time to discover some manners.
entries.source_text: That's it. I warned the Elders that bringin' in an Outsider could be trouble. (shouting aside) Guards! There's an Initiate here who needs some quiet time to discover some manners.

entries.text: You're an Outsider, but I expect you to learn our ways. I'll be watching. Now, ask your questions.
entries.source_text: You're an Outsider, but I expect you to learn our ways. I'll be watching. Now, ask your questions.

entries.text: Good. Anything else you need to ask?
entries.source_text: Good. Anything else you need to ask?

entries.text: Deep in the mountains. He couldn't be more specific.
entries.source_text: Deep in the mountains. He couldn't be more specific.

entries.text: Too bad. Can I ask you a few more questions?
entries.source_text: Too bad. Can I ask you a few more questions?

entries.text: What about to the north?
entries.source_text: What about to the north?

entries.text: Go ahead.
entries.source_text: Go ahead.

entries.text: Yeah, Fire away.
entries.source_text: Yeah, Fire away.

entries.text: Sure.
entries.source_text: Sure.

entries.text: Shoot.
entries.source_text: Shoot.

entries.text: I got a gut feeling there's a small force in the east and a much bigger one in the north. The Elders are collecting dust because none of the scouts returned from the north. I can't do anything but watch.
entries.source_text:
I got a gut feeling there's a small force in the east and
 a much bigger one in the north. The Elders are collecting dust because
 none of the scouts returned from the north. I can't do anything but watch.

entries.text: Well, I'll do what I can.
entries.source_text: Well, I'll do what I can.

entries.text: Why don't you do something?
entries.source_text: Why don't you do something?

entries.text: I think I'm in a bit over my head. Count me out.
entries.source_text: I think I'm in a bit over my head. Count me out.

entries.text: I have some info on that.
entries.source_text: I have some info on that.

entries.text: Well the Merchants from the Hub told us a bunch of caravans disappeared on their way up north. I think there's an army in the mountains, but the Elders, well, they don't want to act until they're sure.
entries.source_text:
Well the Merchants from the Hub told us a bunch of caravans
 disappeared on their way up north. I think there's an army in the mountains,
 but the Elders, well, they don't want to act until they're sure.

entries.text: Where did they disappear?
entries.source_text: Where did they disappear?

entries.text: Aren't you the High Elder? Why don't you do something?
entries.source_text: Aren't you the High Elder? Why don't you do something?

entries.text: Didn't you do anything?
entries.source_text: Didn't you do anything?

entries.text: I have some info on that.
entries.source_text: I have some info on that.

entries.text: The word I got was that the caravans disappeared around the southern tip of the mountains to the east. I imagine the Hub merchants can probably tell you more.
entries.source_text:
The word I got was that the caravans disappeared around the
 southern tip of the mountains to the east. I imagine the Hub merchants can probably
 tell you more.

entries.text: Thanks. I've got some more questions, if that's okay.
entries.source_text: Thanks. I've got some more questions, if that's okay.

entries.text: Thanks. I'll talk to you later.
entries.source_text: Thanks. I'll talk to you later.

entries.text: I have some info on that.
entries.source_text: I have some info on that.

entries.text: See you around, Initiate. You're not so bad...for an Outsider.
entries.source_text: See you around, Initiate. You're not so bad...for an Outsider.

entries.text: Goodbye, Initiate.
entries.source_text: Goodbye, Initiate.

entries.text: Goodbye!
entries.source_text: Goodbye!

entries.text: I grew up too isolated here. Can you imagine spending your whole life inside one small place, then having to go out into the world?
entries.source_text: I grew up too isolated here. Can you imagine spending your whole life inside one small place, then having to go out into the world?

entries.text: Well, as a matter a fact . . .
entries.source_text: Well, as a matter a fact . . .

entries.text: I guess I'm destined to be your scout, then.
entries.source_text: I guess I'm destined to be your scout, then.

entries.text: So because they didn't get out, I get to do your dirty work. Forget it.
entries.source_text: So because they didn't get out, I get to do your dirty work. Forget it.

entries.text: Then you understand the problem. To survive, we need someone who knows the outside. Like you.
entries.source_text: Then you understand the problem. To survive, we need someone who knows the outside. Like you.

entries.text: Ok, I'll do it.
entries.source_text: Ok, I'll do it.

entries.text: I've got my own problems. I pass.
entries.source_text: I've got my own problems. I pass.

entries.text: Well . . . with what I guess is coming, we don't have time for anyone who's gonna . . . not contribute. Now, you either work with us, or you take a hike.
entries.source_text:
Well . . . with what I guess is coming, we don't have time for anyone
 who's gonna . . . not contribute. Now, you either work with us, or you take a hike.

entries.text: Well, if you put it that way, I'm in.
entries.source_text: Well, if you put it that way, I'm in.

entries.text: Looks like a nice day for a stroll.
entries.source_text: Looks like a nice day for a stroll.

entries.text: Your choice. Hope you can live with it.
entries.source_text: Your choice. Hope you can live with it.

entries.text: What? It's who we are and what we live for. It's ideals. As you spend more time with us, hopefully, you'll understand.
entries.source_text:
What? It's who we are and what we live for. It's ideals. As you spend
 more time with us, hopefully, you'll understand.

entries.text: Yeah, but what do you actually do?
entries.source_text: Yeah, but what do you actually do?

entries.text: I'm not too sure about this.
entries.source_text: I'm not too sure about this.

entries.text: Our main goal is to survive. The Scribes copy old plans for weapons or design new ones, and the Knights make the guns from 'em. Most guns come from us.
entries.source_text: Our main goal is to survive. The Scribes copy old plans for weapons or design new ones, and the Knights make the guns from 'em. Most guns come from us.

entries.text: You trade the weapons to the Hub?
entries.source_text: You trade the weapons to the Hub?

entries.text: That's all you do?
entries.source_text: That's all you do?

entries.text: Makes sense. There's a couple of other things I need to ask.
entries.source_text: Makes sense. There's a couple of other things I need to ask.

entries.text: That's the way we get our supplies.
entries.source_text: That's the way we get our supplies.

entries.text: Okay, I get it. There's a couple of other things I need to ask.
entries.source_text: Okay, I get it. There's a couple of other things I need to ask.

entries.text: Okay. I need to get going now, though.
entries.source_text: Okay. I need to get going now, though.

entries.text: Guess I'm not too sure about this.
entries.source_text: Guess I'm not too sure about this.

entries.text: All? It's damn important. It's critical to our survival.
entries.source_text: All? It's damn important. It's critical to our survival.

entries.text: Whatever. I need to ask a few more questions.
entries.source_text: Whatever. I need to ask a few more questions.

entries.text: Yeah, well, it's stupid.
entries.source_text: Yeah, well, it's stupid.

entries.text: Ok, thanks. I really should be going now, though.
entries.source_text: Ok, thanks. I really should be going now, though.

entries.text: Then you need to get sure. Because being unsure is bound to get you killed.
entries.source_text: Then you need to get sure. Because being unsure is bound to get you killed.

entries.text: The more I know, the more sure I'll be.
entries.source_text: The more I know, the more sure I'll be.

entries.text: Look I don't have time for a story that long right now. Here. All of us grew up on this.
entries.source_text: Look I don't have time for a story that long right now. Here. All of us grew up on this.

entries.text: There's rumors concerning the missing caravans in the Hub, as well as the strange army brewing in the eastern mountains.
entries.source_text: There's rumors concerning the missing caravans in the Hub, as well as the strange army brewing in the eastern mountains.

entries.text: Ok.
entries.source_text: Ok.

entries.text: What army?
entries.source_text: What army?

entries.text: What about these missing caravans?
entries.source_text: What about these missing caravans?

entries.text: I have some info on that.
entries.source_text: I have some info on that.

entries.text: I don't take stock in rumors.
entries.source_text: I don't take stock in rumors.

entries.text: Ahh . . . Hello again, Initiate. Are things going well?
entries.source_text: Ahh . . . Hello again, Initiate. Are things going well?

entries.text: Pretty good. Can I ask you a few more questions?
entries.source_text: Pretty good. Can I ask you a few more questions?

entries.text: Well, actually, it sucks.
entries.source_text: Well, actually, it sucks.

entries.text: Yes, thanks, but I gotta go.
entries.source_text: Yes, thanks, but I gotta go.

entries.text: I'm sorry we're not what you're used to but you could show a little self-discipline.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry we're not what you're used to but you could show a little self-discipline.

entries.text: Sorry. Can I ask you a few more questions?
entries.source_text: Sorry. Can I ask you a few more questions?

entries.text: Why? This place is a joke?
entries.source_text: Why? This place is a joke?

entries.text: I have to get going. Bye.
entries.source_text: I have to get going. Bye.

entries.text: What the hell do you want now?
entries.source_text: What the hell do you want now?

entries.text: I want to know why an idiot is in charge here.
entries.source_text: I want to know why an idiot is in charge here.

entries.text: I need to ask a few more questions.
entries.source_text: I need to ask a few more questions.

entries.text: Never mind, thanks.
entries.source_text: Never mind, thanks.

entries.text: Whaddya got?
entries.source_text: Whaddya got?

entries.text: Sorry, I didn't really have anything.
entries.source_text: Sorry, I didn't really have anything.

entries.text: The Hub caravans are being taken by huge, green mutants. They're gathering an army.
entries.source_text: The Hub caravans are being taken by huge, green mutants. They're gathering an army.

entries.text: There's a large army to the north controlled by someone called the Master.
entries.source_text: There's a large army to the north controlled by someone called the Master.

entries.text: You've seen 'em? This might actually get the Elders to do something. I'm gonna get on this, thanks!
entries.source_text:
You've seen 'em? This might actually get the Elders to do something.
 I'm gonna get on this, thanks!

entries.text: Uh . . . What's he plan to do with this . . . army of his?
entries.source_text: Uh . . . What's he plan to do with this . . . army of his?

entries.text: He plans to take over the Brotherhood, the Hub, Junktown . . . everyone.
entries.source_text: He plans to take over the Brotherhood, the Hub, Junktown . . . everyone.

entries.text: How much you paying for this information?
entries.source_text: How much you paying for this information?

entries.text: Finally! Well this'll get the Elders  off their butts. We'll fortify the Fortress and surprise those damn mutants.
entries.source_text: Finally! Well this'll get the Elders  off their butts. We'll fortify the Fortress and surprise those damn mutants.

entries.text: No! You don't understand. They are turning people into mutants and adding them to their army.
entries.source_text: No! You don't understand. They are turning people into mutants and adding them to their army.

entries.text: Okay.
entries.source_text: Okay.

entries.text: So?
entries.source_text: So?

entries.text: So, by the time they get here, they'll be unstoppable. And they have advanced weapons, like yours. You don't stand a chance.
entries.source_text: So, by the time they get here, they'll be unstoppable. And they have advanced weapons, like yours. You don't stand a chance.

entries.text: Well, okay. Maybe digging in is the right thing.
entries.source_text: Well, okay. Maybe digging in is the right thing.

entries.text: So what's your alternative?
entries.source_text: So what's your alternative?

entries.text: Help me attack the Master's base. I know where it is.
entries.source_text: Help me attack the Master's base. I know where it is.

entries.text: Hmmm. Not a bad plan. Tell you what, let me go try and beat it into the Elders. No guarantees, but I'll try.
entries.source_text: Hmmm. Not a bad plan. Tell you what, let me go try and beat it into the Elders. No guarantees, but I'll try.

entries.text: Then get out. I have work to do.
entries.source_text: Then get out. I have work to do.

entries.text: Pretty interesting set of priorities and loyalties you got there.
entries.source_text: Pretty interesting set of priorities and loyalties you got there.

entries.text: Loyal to me. 500 in Hub script. Take it or leave it.
entries.source_text: Loyal to me. 500 in Hub script. Take it or leave it.

entries.text: Oh . . . yeah. Okay, I'll tell you. He plans to take over everyone and everything.
entries.source_text: Oh . . . yeah. Okay, I'll tell you. He plans to take over everyone and everything.

entries.text: I'll take it. We need the information to save lives.
entries.source_text: I'll take it. We need the information to save lives.

entries.text: Pretty simple. He's changing humans into mutants and he's got advanced weapons. He plans to take over everything.
entries.source_text: Pretty simple. He's changing humans into mutants and he's got advanced weapons. He plans to take over everything.

entries.text: Well, if he does, hope you find a place to use your scripts.
entries.source_text: Well, if he does, hope you find a place to use your scripts.

entries.text: Well, how about nothing! Guards, kick this fool out. By God! We'll defend the Brotherhood without your damn help.
entries.source_text:
Well, how about nothing! Guards, kick this fool out. By God!
 We'll defend the Brotherhood without your damn help.

entries.text: What do you think you're doing? Put that down. Put it down now!
entries.source_text: What do you think you're doing? Put that down. Put it down now!

entries.text: That's it. Guards! Take this idiot away!
entries.source_text: That's it. Guards! Take this idiot away!

entries.text: Hey, hey, hey, hey! Hold on now. Stop that. Stop it right now!
entries.source_text: Hey, hey, hey, hey! Hold on now. Stop that. Stop it right now!

entries.text: Like I said...
entries.source_text: Like I said...

entries.text: I said...
entries.source_text: I said...

entries.text: I am not in the habit of repeating myself. So open your ears.
entries.source_text: I am not in the habit of repeating myself. So open your ears.

entries.text: Look I told ya' already. It's not my fault if you didn't get it.
entries.source_text: Look I told ya' already. It's not my fault if you didn't get it.

entries.text: That's where you are. You want the long version, go talk to Vree.
entries.source_text: That's where you are. You want the long version, go talk to Vree.

entries.text: Mathia's my assistant.
entries.source_text: Mathia's my assistant.

entries.text: Oh, he's a good kid, even if he does want to be a Scribe.
entries.source_text: Oh, he's a good kid, even if he does want to be a Scribe.

entries.text: Vree's the head Scribe.  She's usually in the Library, she always likes to talk.
entries.source_text: Vree's the head Scribe.  She's usually in the Library, she always likes to talk.

entries.text: We keep weapon specs and history there.
entries.source_text: We keep weapon specs and history there.

entries.text: Rhombo's been here a long time. A bit stiff, but a helluva soldier.
entries.source_text: Rhombo's been here a long time. A bit stiff, but a helluva soldier.

entries.text: Hehehe. A fine, handsome, upstanding man. The High Elder position is to mediate the meetings between the Elders. You see, two years ago I got talked into it. If I'd of known then...
entries.source_text: Hehehe. A fine, handsome, upstanding man. The High Elder position is to mediate the meetings between the Elders. You see, two years ago I got talked into it. If I'd of known then...

entries.text: Well you see there's four of them and that's about all they can ever agree on. They can't even agree if they want to piss, much less pick a pot to piss in.
entries.source_text: Well you see there's four of them and that's about all they can ever agree on. They can't even agree if they want to piss, much less pick a pot to piss in.

entries.text: Well that's what you are. Initiates train and learn to become knights or scribes.
entries.source_text: Well that's what you are. Initiates train and learn to become knights or scribes.

entries.text: Well, Scribes copy down the weapon specs. We've got information all the way back to my granddad. Sometimes a scribe comes up with a new idea for a weapon. Hehehe. Doesn't happen too often. They all answer to Vree.
entries.source_text:
Well, Scribes copy down the weapon specs. We've got information all the way back to
 my granddad. Sometimes a scribe comes up with a new idea for a weapon. Hehehe. Doesn't happen too often.
 They all answer to Vree.

entries.text: The Knights make the weapons. And when he's good enough, a Knight can advance to become a Paladin and then an Elder and so forth. Right now Rhombus is the head of the Knights.
entries.source_text: The Knights make the weapons. And when he's good enough, a Knight can advance to become a Paladin and then an Elder and so forth. Right now Rhombus is the head of the Knights.

entries.text: Paladins are in charge of all security and outside activities. I remember tradin' with the Hub, goin' on scouting missions for the Elders. Ah man, those ware a good times.
entries.source_text: Paladins are in charge of all security and outside activities. I remember tradin' with the Hub, goin' on scouting missions for the Elders. Ah man, those ware a good times.

entries.text: The Hub's down to the southeast. They trade us food and things for the weapons we make here. Now if you're ever down there, you talk to Butch Harris.
entries.source_text: The Hub's down to the southeast. They trade us food and things for the weapons we make here. Now if you're ever down there, you talk to Butch Harris.

entries.text: Butch is the head of the Far Go Traders. He's a little slimy, but he's not a total waste. Unlike those Water Merchants. Bunch of damn vultures, all of 'em.
entries.source_text: Butch is the head of the Far Go Traders. He's a little slimy, but he's not a total waste. Unlike those Water Merchants. Bunch of damn vultures, all of 'em.

entries.text: They're the main ones we trade with. Not totally trustworthy, but not as bad as the others.
entries.source_text: They're the main ones we trade with. Not totally trustworthy, but not as bad as the others.

entries.text: You can't trust them. A few years ago, they offered us Water for a huge stockpile of weapons. We told them no, and you know what they did? Sent in thieves to steal the weapons! We caught 'em, but the Elders voted down going to the Hub to teach the merchants a lesson.
entries.source_text: You can't trust them. A few years ago, they offered us Water for a huge stockpile of weapons. We told them no, and you know what they did? Sent in thieves to steal the weapons! We caught 'em, but the Elders voted down going to the Hub to teach the merchants a lesson.

entries.text: Holo discs? Hmm? I haven't seen those in a while.
entries.source_text: Holo discs? Hmm? I haven't seen those in a while.

entries.text: Vree has it someplace in the Library.
entries.source_text: Vree has it someplace in the Library.

entries.text: Roger Maxson huh? Well he led our people here in the great Exodus, started the Brotherhood from scratch. Quite a leader.
entries.source_text: Roger Maxson huh? Well he led our people here in the great Exodus, started the Brotherhood from scratch. Quite a leader.

entries.text: Well that was when my granddad, Roger Maxson, led his soldiers here and started the Brotherhood. He never mentioned where they came from, but it  doesn't really matter, 'cause...well, this is our home now.
entries.source_text: Well that was when my granddad, Roger Maxson, led his soldiers here and started the Brotherhood. He never mentioned where they came from, but it  doesn't really matter, 'cause...well, this is our home now.

entries.text: Well I believe there's an army massing to the north and in the mountains to the east, but I don't have any way to prove it. The Elders, they won't even listen.
entries.source_text: Well I believe there's an army massing to the north and in the mountains to the east, but I don't have any way to prove it. The Elders, they won't even listen.

entries.text: A bunch of religious whackos, if you ask me. I think their main church is in the Boneyard.
entries.source_text: A bunch of religious whackos, if you ask me. I think their main church is in the Boneyard.

entries.text: Well I don't know a lot. There's a bunch of gangs around there, as well as Adytum and the Children of the Cathedral. Not much else. It's pretty damn desolate.
entries.source_text: Well I don't know a lot. There's a bunch of gangs around there, as well as Adytum and the Children of the Cathedral. Not much else. It's pretty damn desolate.

entries.text: Well, there's not much to tell. I never ran into any of them. I've heard they're a problem for the people of Adytum, though.
entries.source_text: Well, there's not much to tell. I never ran into any of them. I've heard they're a problem for the people of Adytum, though.

entries.text: That's a settlement down in the Boneyard. I went there...oh...a long time ago. I was on a scouting mission for the Elders.
